neighbours.label: A research or data noun that opens a cited-source attribution in science news ('In a study [published in]', 'according to federal data', 'The findings, reported in'), vs the same nouns used outside an attribution frame
fire: Doctors were surprised. In a large study published last month in JAMA, aspirin showed no benefit.
Coral cover has dropped sharply, according to federal survey data.
The new analysis, reported this week in Nature Climate Change, links the heat to drought.
Teen sleep is getting shorter. In research published in Pediatrics, the decline was steepest.
Bee populations rebounded in 2023, according to state agriculture data.
The results, published online in Cell, describe a new class of antibiotics.
Scientists remain cautious. In a recent paper published in Science, the effect was small.
The findings, presented at a cardiology meeting, suggest a cheaper treatment.
quiet: Doctors were surprised. In a large room on the third floor, the patients waited.
Coral reefs are beautiful, and divers love their bright colours.
The new analyst started this week and sits near the window.
Teen sleep is getting shorter. In the study hall, students often doze.
Bee populations rebounded in 2023, and the farmers were relieved.
The results of the bake sale were posted on the school door.
Scientists remain cautious. My cousin wrote a paper on volcanoes in school.
The finding of the lost dog made the whole street happy.

predictions: Attribution frames 0.25-0.5 on the noun or following comma; the same nouns in everyday non-citation use under 0.1.
short: source noun opening a science-news citation
notes: Card: ',' x16 after 'study/hypothesis/work' and ' study/research/findings/data' before 'published/reported'. Promotes nothing relevant on +; the pole fires on the noun before the participle, so it anticipates the attribution. Probe: 'In a new study published' 0.419 on ' study', 'according to government data' 0.355, 'The new findings, reported' 0.300, 'The latest research, published' 0.301; 'The study room' 0.073, 'did his research at the library' 0.007.
